name: ogrecords
description: Read your OGRECORDS music distribution account: releases, store status, stream counts, smart links and balance. Read-only.

interface.longDescription:
OGRECORDS is a music distribution and marketing platform for independent artists and labels. Connect your OGRECORDS account and ask about your catalog in plain language: which releases are live or still in review, how many streams a release had in the last 30 days and in which countries, the tracks of a release, your roster, your smart links, your balance and past payouts. It also answers general questions about OGRECORDS from the public help centre.

Read-only by design: the app cannot submit, change, take down or delete anything, and never sees passwords, bank details, ID documents or contracts. You choose which areas to share on the OGRECORDS consent screen and can disconnect at any time under Settings > Connected apps in your OGRECORDS dashboard.

Stream counts are a lower bound: YouTube and TikTok are not included, and stores report the most recent 24 to 72 hours late.

Requires an OGRECORDS account.
defaultPrompt: Which of my releases are live, and which are still in review?
How many streams did my newest release get in the last 30 days?
What is my current OGRECORDS balance?
